facts.claim: Nirmal Town is the fortified headquarters of the taluk of the same name in Adilabad District, Hyderabad State.
facts.quote: Nirmal Town. — Fortified town and head-quarters of the tdluk of the same name in Adilabad District, Hyderabad State, situated in 19° 6' N. and 78° 21' E.

facts.claim: The population of Nirmal Town in 1901 was 7,751.
The main fortifications of Nirmal Town were built by French officers in the Nizam's service and still contain a number of guns.
facts.quote: The main fortifications were built by French officers in the Nizam's service, and are still in good preserva- tion, and contain a number of guns.
